summary.intent: Autonomously run the full post-execute-phase ship loop (verify → secure → validate → simplify → SDK E2E gate → CodeRabbit review → ship → resolve PR reviews → extract learnings) for GSD phase 69 (FUSE/WinFsp Rust integration and grant-root awareness) in cipher-box, triaging every finding without asking and deferring risky/out-of-scope items as todos.
summary.outcome: Steps 1-4 completed and committed (verification PASSED, security SECURED with threats_open:0, validation reconciled to compliant, simplify closed with no changes needed). CodeRabbit CLI review (full-diff timed out, then scoped per-directory) surfaced 32+ findings across crates/sdk, crates/fuse, and crates/core; four parallel adversarial-verification agents confirmed which were real vs. CodeRabbit misreads, and ~13 verified-safe fixes were applied across 8 files (including a CRITICAL read-after-write EIO bug in read_ops.rs), with risky/large items deferred to three new todo files. All 476 workspace tests still pass after fixes; code fixes were committed. Shipping, PR review resolution, and learnings extraction had not yet run by the end of the transcript.

repo: cipher-box squash-merges PRs, so branch commit history never reaches release-please post-merge — only the PR title needs to be conventional/paren-free; per-commit rewording (filter-branch) is unnecessary busywork.

.github/scripts/pr-release-preview.js commit regex captures the description as `.+` (tolerates parens) and explicitly skips merge commits — it only fails on the non-conventional `feat NN-NN:` (space) subject format.
No CI clippy gate exists in this repo (no `-D warnings` enforcement); most clippy warnings on phase-touched files are pre-existing or in the vendored `fuser` crate, not new regressions.
CodeRabbit CLI times out summarizing full diffs beyond ~125 files/24k lines; scope reviews per-directory with `--dir` instead of running against the whole diff.

CodeRabbit CLI free tier rate-limits after several scoped runs in quick succession (hit a 46-min wait on the 4th scope, apps/desktop) — the PR-level review after `gh pr create` has no such CLI limit and can absorb the remainder.

`desktop-e2e.yml`'s `workflow_dispatch` takes no inputs — `gh workflow run "Desktop E2E Tests" --ref <branch>` runs the full macOS/Windows/Linux matrix directly against that branch head; `ci-e2e.yml` is a separate orchestrator that calls the same matrix job on dispatch, plus web-e2e.
markdownlint excludes `.planning/` on commit but prettier still runs there — relevant when committing VERIFICATION/SECURITY/VALIDATION/todo markdown.

code.finding: `is_unresolved` duplicated the enclosing `cid.is_empty()` check, making the `pending_content`/empty-file fallback unreachable — read-after-write on a locally-buffered file returned EIO instead of serving pending content. Fixed by serving `pending_content` at the top of the empty-CID block and letting `handle_open` succeed for pending-write files.
`InodeKind`'s derived `Debug` leaked zeroized key material via `Zeroizing`'s forwarding Debug impl; replaced with a manual redacting `Debug` implementation.
`MetadataCache` stores `""` in the `cid` field as a freshness marker, so `old_cid` can be `Some("")` — a filter was needed to avoid treating that as a real prior CID.

Non-atomic read-modify-write on the floor store is an inherited property of a faithful port of the shipped TS `rotation-high-water.ts` under an explicit single-daemon model, not a Rust-specific regression — CodeRabbit's atomicity findings here were deferred rather than fixed as bugs.

`run_scope_exit_gate` is already live on every delete (delete.rs:200,399) and rename (rename.rs:102), but the rotation it can trigger is not wired to a production `RotationDeps` — it fails closed (EIO) rather than silently skipping, matching the known ROT-07 deferral.
Added `deny_unknown_fields` hardening; confirmed safe because the encoder emits exactly the expected fields and KAT vector tests stayed green.
The CAS publish loop leaked the uploaded CID's pin on early-return (`?`) failure paths; wrapped with best-effort unpin on all failure branches.

TEE-enrollment match needed to be hoisted above `upload_content` so a missing epoch or wrap failure errors before the blob is pinned; also added zeroization for replay child keys and fixed both-plane idempotency.

workflow: Spawning parallel adversarial-verification agents (with explicit context: faithful-TS-port, single-daemon model, the known 48/89 zeroization-reuse trap, and the not-yet-live grant-scope path) caught several CodeRabbit findings that were FALSE and would have introduced regressions if blindly applied (e.g., misreading rotation-epoch/version_floor args as dropped metadata, or 'fixing' write-generation protection that already lives one layer up).
When multiple verification agents read overlapping files, hold all edits until every agent returns, then apply fixes in one serialized pass to avoid racing concurrent reads.
Run heavy suites (full cargo workspace test) centrally as the orchestrator in the background rather than inside subagents, consistent with prior RAM-starvation lesson.

When a canonical artifact (e.g., VERIFICATION.md) doesn't exist because an earlier phase step skipped it, generating it directly via goal-backward analysis is faster and more accurate than invoking the conversational/UAT-oriented skill meant for a different purpose.

friction: `/gsd-verify-work` invoked the conversational UAT skill, which was the wrong tool for an autonomous CI-gated Rust phase; no `69-VERIFICATION.md` existed because execute-phase's verify step never produced one, requiring manual redirection to goal-backward verification.

The gsd-security-auditor subagent stalled mid-stream ("API Error: Response stalled mid-stream") after ~7.5 minutes and 17 tool uses, dying without writing `69-SECURITY.md` — had to be reconstructed manually from the threat register instead of re-spawning a stall-prone agent.
CodeRabbit CLI timed out summarizing the full 125-file/24k-line diff, requiring a fallback to per-directory scoped reviews.
CodeRabbit's `apps/desktop`-scoped review hit a free-tier rate limit (46-minute wait), leaving that area only opportunistically scanned rather than formally reviewed pre-PR.
Initial threat-disposition count (6 'accept') was wrong because it counted the word 'accept' in prose rather than parsing the actual disposition column; corrected to 4 via a clean TSV extraction.
A leftover `pr-body.md` file from a prior run in the same jobs temp directory required switching to a phase-specific filename to avoid collision.

SDK floor-store concurrency/atomicity hardening deferred to `.planning/todos/pending/2026-07-07-sdk-floor-store-concurrency-atomicity.md`.

Fuse publish/concurrency hardening items (journal_helpers key-hygiene Zeroizing promotion, dead clone removal, CAS-retry consolidation, desktop hygiene notes) deferred to `.planning/todos/pending/2026-07-07-fuse-publish-and-concurrency-hardening-deferred.md`.

User added a hard gate mid-session: full `Desktop E2E Tests` matrix (macOS/Windows/Linux) must be dispatched against the final shipped SHA and pass green before merge sign-off, alongside PR checks and the `cargo-windows` gate — not yet dispatched as of end of transcript.
